reviews.review_description: All team delivered as promised and ahead of schedule. They were clear in explaining how it operates and demonstrating how to use of the sungrow interface app and operation of the EV charger.

After i learnt as much as i could as a novice on battery system, the process was good. Except for one sales person who told me what i wanted, all 3 recommended for solar quotes were good. I found the most customer focused was Connor from Essential Energy Solutions. The team, led by Brad, that removed our old system & installed our new Solar System (panels, inverter & battery) were great, fully focused on the job. Installation went smoothly & they left the site spotless.I did not have to organize any paperwork for connection & approvals.

The salesman wasn't pushy, but knowledgeable about the product.The installation was seamless and the site manager very confident, competent, and cooperative.  He didn't leave until everything was installed, connected, and cleaned up.Top marks!

From the quote to the paper work and then the installation the EES team were very helpful and professional.The panels, inverter, battery and wiring look neat and tidy. We got Trina panels with Sungrow inverter and batteries.The system works better than I expected. The battery gets us through most nights and when the grid has failed, a couple of times in the last 4 months, we had power.

The quoting process was very interactive, professional, friendly, and knowledgeable, with the representative answering many beginner questions. Others were not as familiar with the systems as we had become due to SolarQuotes' information.On-site review preceded the quote. Other installers did not want to visit.Installation was spectacular. Worked perfectly. We felt like we were being used to train new staff, which we were happy to be part of, given the demand that likely follows, and with us being an early installation taking advantage of the government incentive. They kept us in the loop at every step. They even reduced the quoted costs due to some changes made on the day. They arrived ready to work, on time, were polite, informative and friendly and cleaned up after themselves. They were very collaborative in determining which emergency circuits would be powered by the battery in the event of a total power failure.We had a walk-through of the system, although there wasn't much to actually know/do. Tested the blackstart performance. Quoted us on new fire alarms for the entire house as well! They cared and were customer-focused throughout.Great team and great install. And now we can watch zero Watts of our energy arriving via the grid - all coming from fresh or battery-stored space photons! How cool is that!
The whole process was excellent. The sale person arrived on time. Quick installation. The installers were tidy and punctual.

Having 3 quotes made it relatively easy for one to stand out as the right one for us. Essential Energy were easy to deal with, very informative and very professional in their approach. I would recommend them.

From the first visit to every point of contact since these guys have been amazing. I also requested that my old powerboard be replaced, which wasn't a problem and was done as part of the solar installation.So far no issues, just waiting for the retailer to finish the connection then we can give the system a whirl.They took care of everything, were a great bunch of guys, and cleaned up when they were done. It all looks great.I would recommend them and am currently waiting on quotes to have other electrical work done.
Provided fantastic level of advice and support in selecting system. Very happy

The whole process from quoting to installation was very professional. The salesman was prompt, and very informative, responding to follow up questions in a timely manner. The administrative staff were also very helpful and assisted us with the rebate process. Finally the installation was completed on time and all tradesmen were competent and respectful, carefully explaining the operation of the system.

The crew arrived on time. Did a great job of hiding the wiring.  They shifted a tv antenna without a problem.  Also broke a few tiles, as expected,  but I had prepared replacements so the install was painless. Had a 32 amp single phase outlet installed for a future ev.The system looks great, but still waiting for origin energy to replace the electricity meter before we can realise the benefits. This is booked to happen 15 days after install, also quite reasonable.The initial consultation with Connor, through to the installation and payments was seamless.

The whole process was smooth and straight forward.  We were very impressed with the installation Brad and his crew were a nice bunch of guys very professional and well mannered.  On the day they were punctual and got on with the job everyone knew their role truly they were a well oiled machine it was very impressive to watch.  They were very clean and tidy it was like they were never there.  I highly recommend Essential Energy Solutions.
My five stars says it all. Nothing further to add.
The entire process was made so easy. Very neat and tidy job and is working beautifully.

Essential Energy Solutions was the only one to actually physically come to my home for the quote.Really easy to deal with. Customer service excellent!Installation was fast, clean and professional.Highly recommended.
Quote process was easy, and the quote was informative and detailed. The installers were on time and their work was faultless.
Essential Energy Solutions QLD is a fantastic family business and did the installation in a timely manner. They’re professionalism is second to none and we recommend them without any hesitation.

We could not be happier with our installer. They helped us get the right system for our use case and budget and helped us with all little details leading up to and after the installation. Which was great as these was our first solar panels, ever.Installers didn't even break a tile. Magic.

I had already done a fair bit of research before I found solar quotes, but wasn't sure which installer that had quoted me was the right choice. Fortunately my friends had a great experience with a solar quotes trusted installer earlier in the year and recommended that I take a look. My quotes came in quickly and the price from Essential Energy was even better than the quotes I had already received so I booked them, and they were super easy to work with and I didnt have any trouble at all. Joe from their team came for the initial inspection and was great at explaining everything, and the team was quick, friendly and tidy on install day. Highly recommended! Thanks guys!

Sales guy made promo appointment and turned up right on time.  He explained everything well and took me through all the stages.  I had some questions regarding quality of brands which had been offered to me by his company and some others.  His advice and comments were honest and straight forward.  In the end I upgraded and had 3 quote revisions to finally arrive at the system I wanted at a competitive price.  Installation guys were great and this was very important to me so I was really pleased.  In summary, going with Essential proved to be a good decision and experience for me.  I would recommend them!

Sales/quoting process respectful and timely.Installation was polite, tidy and punctual while I was treated respectfully with any questions answered easily. The installation was the best experience we have had with people working on our property.Haven't organised a grid connection yet, however I am sure they will help. Very confident in their after sales service.

Our solar install through Essential Energy Solutions was seamless, from booking the first face to face meeting, to the final installation and handover. We were provided helpful information by the salesperson which helped us make informed decisions about system size, quality components and peripherals like the Catch solar relay and how to manage our monitoring programs. The install itself was finished to spec with no dramas. We know we can ask any follow-up questions to help ease our transition into the solar energy world!

Sales quoting was done on site and with prompt feedback and responses to questions.Installation was quicker than expected.  Great team, polite and punctual.Grid connection was initiated within 2 hours of the installation and was connected to my supplier within 7 days

From the salesperson to the electrician and the installers, each and every one of them done a fantastic job. It is hard to find good tradesman these days and it is just such a relief when you do. They come when they said they would, done what they said they would and left the place how they found it. Very happy customer who has already referred Essential Energy to 2 other people.
Quick and efficient installation and system working as described. Salesperson quoted on system best suited to our home and needs.
No bullshit approach to assisting me to put in a new system.  As I had already had a system I knew what I wanted and Essential assisted me rather than a sales approach I received from others.
The team at Essential were prompt with following up the inquiry and attended my home to explain.They displayed genuine interest and explained things well.

Process is easy, sales person comes out and explains everything is easy clear language. Once you get a quote and accept it, easy to understand email get sent out to start process. Had no issues with whole installation process. High recommend.

The quoting process went smoothly. Conner was very knowledgeable and everything we discussed was able to happen on the day. The rest of the presales team were very helpful and prompt. There were no issues at all.The installation team we prompt, cleaned up after themselves and did a neat job. Once there and looking at the roof layout, surrounding trees and grade of the block Chris was able to suggest a layout that work best for our roof.Chris explained all of the apps and how the system worked.The solar catch relay they suggested so far is great. Making utilising the hotwater system to only use solar unless it has been a very cloudy day.They are organising the new meter to be installed making my job very easy.

Sales process was efficient and the communication about the system was very clear and precise. The installation was efficient, the staff were very polite and obliging. Couldn't fault them. Right from the initial contact everything went smoothly and efficiently. Even contacted me on the way here ( Toowoomba) to let me know their estimated arrival time. From the moment I paid the deposit and signed the contract , a date was booked and Ergon contacted. I received my email from Ergon the next day confirming all good to go. I just couldn't get over the efficiency of this Company from Quoting to Installation and the follow up of the Administration staff.  Thank you Essential Energy Solutions I really appreciated everything you did for me.  What's the saying ? " Simply the Best"!

Punctual and good communication through the quote process. Paid attention to what was important to us. Installed the system with little inconvenience to us. Very polite and friendly installation crew.  They cleaned up. After themselves.  Excellent after sales service. They were not the cheapest and they were not the most expensive but they were very good. Would recommend. The fact that they are located fairly close and they have been in business for a long time gives us confidence. They have offered and promised their services after sales should we encounter any problems
The quoting process was thorough and connor was friendly and helpful.The installation team was efficient and thoughtful.This team was helpful in every way and I feel very supported by their company

Essential Energy Solutions installed a 25KW solar system with 2 x Tesla Batteries. Their level of service from the time of the quote to installation and commissioning was exceptional. The system is running fantastic and i would highly recommend the EES team. Thank you so much for a job well don.

We appreciated the opportunity to extensively discuss the system layout and options with the installer before quoting. EES was the only installer who visited the site and discussed options before quoting. EES's install team worked very hard all day. They communicated well and were happy to answer all of our questions. Since the installation, they have organised the meter upgrade and helped with operation of the Fronius Smart Meter. Overall, we have been very happy with all of the work.
Easy to organise quote, easy to work with timelines and such on time, guys did a great job, looks good.
Installation was done as per schedule advised and the team were polite and professional.

Our project was to replace an existing off-grid system that had reached its use-by-date, with all new components... solar panels, inverters, batteries, etc..Our requirements were a bit less than straight forward and we wanted a system with flexibility for future expansion. Essential Energy impressed with their willingness to help us explore available options for our system and design around our challenges.The installation team were professional and good-humoured for the duration of a very long day... they were responsive and accommodating, and did a careful, neat job.Our thanks to everyone at Essential Energy.
Great service and genuine advice. Came out to have a look to provide quote and no surprises during install. Very happy.

Essential Energy Solutions kept me informed up to the date of installation and competed the work as quoted on the day. I had some unforeseen additional work needed to install a circuit for an electric water heater to replace the old gas heater, and they were willing and able to do that as well for a very reasonable price. Handover of the system.was also thorough.Very happy with everything.

Installation was scheduled for 7.30 am Monday 20th February and the installers turned up on the day, on time and went straight to work. The whole process was completed by 1.00pm and they cleaned up and took all their rubbish away. Except for there now being panels on the roof and an inverter in the garage you wouldn't know they'd been here.The grid connection was arranged prior to the installation, 3rd January, and I was provided with the Energex application Reference number.The whole process from quotation to grid connection and new meter being fitted was totally painless. I am happy to heartily recommend Essential Energy to anyone.
From first contact to delivery of system, Essential were outstanding at every moment
Professional Team, Sales / Chris and Install team, very pleased with the whole process, Thanks Steve / Deb Cheers

I am so glad I chose Essential Energy Solutions for my solar installation. The team was top notch, working hard on a hot day to get the job done and even bringing in extra workers to make sure everything was completed on time. I was blown away by the quality of the equipment, specifically the Sungrow inverter and Canadian Solar panels, and was pleasantly surprised by the competitive pricing for the level of work and equipment provided. The team was always available to answer any questions and made the financing process a breeze with the help of Brighte Finance. I am now enjoying the benefits of clean, renewable energy and would highly recommend Essential Energy Solutions to anyone in the market for solar panels. Thank you for making the experience so effortless.

We were really impressed by the Essential Energy Solutions team. The installation went smoothly and efficiently. The integration with our existing system was smooth and painless.We would have no hesitation in recommending them.
Great communication all the way through from quote to installation. Very neat and tidy job and friendly service.

Sales and quoting process was very easy.  Connor came to our house and answered all of the questions that we had.  He provided us with a detailed quote and then updated the quote when we made some changes.  He let us know that he was available if we had questions.  No pushy sales, just honest and upfront information provided.Essential Energy Solutions provided excellent customer service via email and phone and quickly responded to any questions we had.The team doing the installation arrived early and were polite and friendly.  They explained what they were doing and tidied up everything before they left.  Install went very smoothly.They helped to organize connection to the grid and explained how to connect to the app.

From start to finish, Essential Energy delivered on everything.From the first meeting getting a quote, to cleaning up after the instal, it was nothing but first class. They even replaced broken tiles with my spares, everything was done for me, I just paid them some money. By far the easiest thing I’ve had to do in regards to works done around the home.Highly recommended.
Great service and product for reasonable price. Looking forward to all the savings!! Thanks!!

Connor provided several variations on the quote as we worked through various inverter and panel options. We have varying levels of shade, so there were options involving string and microinverters.In the end we opted for more panels (we have the roof space) and a Fronius inverter.Brad the electrician and his crew did an top quality job for installation.Not every was perfect, a miscalculation resulted in an accidental hole through the ceiling into our living room Hence I have to give them only four stars on Installation. Essential Energy has been very apologetic and has promised to have the hole repaired at their expense.

Salesperson was honest, not yabbering on about endless stats etc.  Quick and to the point…. Gave advice on system requirements.  What we can achieve with our house, best brand for us, timeframe for starting job was correct.Install team were efficient, able to also move tv antenna, no rubbish left behind, all team meme era very polite and easy going.App is easy to use and set up for us by Essential energy Solutions.

Sales and quoting was very detailed and gave options for different requirements. The install team were efficient and ensured we were kept up to date as we had some weather delays. All back of house details were handled promptlyOverall an great experience from start to finish. I would highly recommend Dale and the Essential Energy team!
Performed very well….extremely professional. Did what they said they would do in the timeframe.

Sales and quoting experience was excellent. (note that of the three quotes they were the only ones to follow up!)The system we decided on was our choice and was a middle of the road solution for our budget.  There was no pressure at all from the sales guy.Installation went really smoothly: they were done by lunch, cleaned up etc. all good.They also did some minor electrical work while they were here and that was very good value.

Everything about Essential Energy Solutions QLD from sales through to install and grid connection went without a hitch. Sales were friendly and helpful. They weren't sleezy and didn't try to up sell. Installation crew were on time and did a very neat and tidy job. And the grid connection was all organised on the same day. I really cannot fault the process at all.
The quote was good and clear.  Followup questions were readily answered.The installation was on time and efficient.  Polite installer teamGrid connection still to be completed

From 1st contact, face-to-face meeting and installation, everything ran very smoothly. I was kept up to date with the process and timelines. The four-man crew that installed the panels and inverter were super friendly, respectful and tidy. Lois, from Administration, kept me informed and updated on all the steps post installation with regards to my retailer and possible changes.
The people at Essential Energy Solutions are very professional and knowledgeable. Very happy with dealing with them.
Sales and quote process was seamless.Installation staff super helpful and friendly.
Visited the property during the quote process and very willing to answer questions. Excellent customer service and communication throughout. Always quick to respond to questions and issues.
The solar quoting process went well,virtually flipped a coin to decide on installation company.Sales and installers for the chosen system were great, very polite, clean and punctual.

From the minute the guys turned up they were into a rhythm that looked practiced and professional.They checked on the placement of the inverter, stepped through all they had done, labelled everything, and provided advice on how to get best use from the system.The team lead stayed behind an hour after the others had left trying to troubleshoot wifi connection issues, which turned out to be due to my wifi router and nothing to do with the solar system or app.The place was spotless after they left.I was very impressed and highly recommend them.

Essential energy solutions provided great customer service. They came to my house and answered all my questions about solar. They also installed the system within a week of me talking to them. The installation team were very professional and did a great job.

The sales quoting process was punctial and quick. Giving me exactly what I needed to know. THe installers where polite and punctial informing me of any thing that need to be done that was not to plan( i.e. I neeeded to buy a smoke alarm since the one they had would not interconnect with my system). Custoimer service was straight forward and on time.

Salesperson punctual and provided options of panel size and location that I found aesthetically pleasing.Kept me informed of installation timings.Installation quick, tidy and minimally disruptive.Would recommend.

Friendly and informative sales person.No upselling and there was no pressure sales tactics used. I wanted 'decent' brands but not top shelf and I believe that is exactly what they provided. eg 'best bang for buck' without buying rubbish that will cause issues later on.Very responsive to follow-up design changes and questions.Capable and willing to do other cabling work at the same time. eg remove old Foxtel dish, relocate TV antenna to not shade panels, hide/remove existing ugly cabling which ran on top of the roof.Great communication and very punctual with regarding to the installation process.Good options provided on the day for the finer details of the installation.Very tidy work! The panels are neat, the racking is minimal (no unnecessary racking extending out the ends), the cabling was all run within the walls. It's all just perfect and super tidy.Post install support has also been good. They have organised the new smart meter and grid connection with the energy provider. Also there seems to be an issue with the app for my inverters, they have opened a support ticket with the manufacturer to get it addressed. These 2 items are currently still open (it's only be a couple of days) but I have every confidence that the company will see them through and resolve any issues. They respond to my emails within a few hours and have been very helpful.I highly recommend Essential Energy Solutions

I went with Essential Energy because their sales person, Kurt, was friendly, helpful, and provided clear and understandable information. Their quote was on par with others I received and they were more than happy to do a site visit before providing a quote.Unfortunately, there were a couple of hiccups in the process. The quoted inverter (Growatt) was incompatible with a two-string panel arrangement. This should have been picked up on when the quote was generated. I ended up having to pay an additional fee for a Fronius inverter. On install day, the team found the meter was non-compliant and additional costly work was required to relocate it to another location on the house. The work that ended up being performed was of high quality with good attention to detail.Thankfully, the company owner was all too happy to talk through the issues and propose an agreeable solution. Although some delays and additional costs (about 20% extra above the initial quote) were incurred, the issues were handled promptly and helpfully.Taking the full experience into consideration, I would recommend Essential Energy Solutions to any Brisbane-based homeowner looking for solar.
upgrade/repair of existing system. Installer arrived on time - polite and tidy - monitoring setup failed

Essential Energy Solutions provided good information and advice through the quoting process, even though I asked for a range of quotes on different specs. They were the only providers that came to premises for the quote.  They turned up on time on the day, offered a couple of alternatives on the installation layout, and were accommodating when I change my mind!  They even removed a satellite dish for me.  Inverter neatly installed. Very professional and polite service - top notch.  Everything was arranged including the grid connection, setting up the monitoring application and account, connecting to wifi etc.  Very happy.
Quality products and very smooth and professional installation.Can't fault it so far.
The sales advice was clear and practical and installation was excellent. I am very happy so far.
All of the process went smoothly. The quoting, installation was efficient. I did not feel pressure. My questions were answered.

The quote was in person and informative. Price did change as I had delays confirming back but they adjusted the panels to try reduce the increase. Great help taking off old system so the roof could be painted. New install was quick, on time and very tidy. Great service.
Easy process. All details were handled well by Essential Energy. Everything well explained.

From quote to installation, and communication from admin, Essential Energy Solutions were fantastic. Prompt and efficient, they answered my questions and provided a great service. The installation team were exceptional, what proved to be a challenge with inclement weather, and difficult access was no barrier. The team were persistent and their problem solving was excellent. I am very very have with the service I have received and more than happy to recommend to anyone.
Hard working amiable group of young men very pleased with the whole process
Customer service was excellent and they also helped with the grid connection after the install

The quoting, admin backup, and installation process was seamless and we couldn't be more delighted with the end result. Installation only took place today so we are yet to see actual daily / weekly energy output so can't comment on that aspect. However the app which we are using to monitor the system (easy to install, easy to see what is happening) shows very positive feed-in levels on this bright sunny day.We obtained 3 quotes which were all similar in price, however from our research we were satisfied Essential Energy Solutions provide us with the best quality equipment at a reasonable price. The service provided by Kurt (who did the quote), Lois (in Admin) and the guys who did the installation was all first class.Seriously, we couldn't be happier with the process or the outcome.Well done Essential Energy Solutions.

Great and honest service.No hard sell, best price straight up and no hounding.Installers were great.Asked a follow up question after install and efficient reply.So far can’t fault anything from start to finish.

Very happy on a professional installation and was prepare to quote on the higher quality panels as i wanted value for money and not the cheapest price. They were very punctual and the job was done in a timely manner.

This is the company to use if you want to avoid disappointment. They were professional throughout the process and their quote was reasonable. There were no sales tactics or elaborage promises. The quote was after they understood my energy needs and possible future plans. Install was on point. Some difficulties with my unique house were handled well.  The electrician even gave me his mobile after the install in case there were any issues. That probably says it all.

The sales quoting experience was positive as I selected 3 installers from a number suggested by Solar Quotes and added another from an installer who did a good install for a family member. Kurt from Essential Energy Solutions (EES) provided great customer service as he is knowledgeable, competent and not a pushy salesman. I felt confident that we were in good hands when I selected EES as our installer.The day after I paid the deposit, Lois in the EES office started the ball rolling by lodging the Energex application on our behalf.The installation went seamlessly; the install team arrived on time on the day promised and just set to work. I was really impressed with the foreman, Matt and the other 3 guys in the team who just got stuck in and did the job without any fuss. They didn't require working to loud and intrusive music that could be heard throughout the neighbourhood and they are all nice, well-mannered guys.The site was left tidy after the job was completed and Matt gave me a run through on the system and explained the settings on the monitoring software.The day after I paid the balance of the contract, I received the warranties for the inverter and the panels as well as a reminder about contacting my electricity retailer to arrange for the smart meter installation.Kurt and his staff from EES did a first rate job of designing and installing my solar system.
Came to my house to discuss the requirements didn't try to up sell and very knowledgeable with different options I would recommend this company

The sales rep from EES saw me to discuss what system they would provide.  He was polite, not at all pushy and knowledgable. He assured me that the installers used by the company would do a good job.  I am pleased to say that that the installation was done well.  The tradesmen were polite, did quality work and cleaned up before they left.At one stage I had to change the installation date and was pleased that it was done with no fuss. Overall, it was a good experience and I would definitely recommend EES as they have good pricing, sell quality products, and do a professional installation.

No complaintsVery thorough from sales person to installation. There was no BS from salesperson and he was honest throughout. The company said what they will do and they did it. It was a hot day on install so I appreciate the installers work. Having some issues currently with inverter operating temp but it's being addressed at the same time.

Three companies quoted and EES offered the best deal. 4 weeks from signing to installation. Old 3kw system removed and new 10.2kw system installed. 6 staff members performed the installation including bird proofing. Completed in one day. Very efficient process with no hiccups.
Great job, excellent stuff , affordable priceDefinitely recommended for any one.
Yes tidy and assisted on all of the mentioned points.
Chose this company because everything was efficient, friendly, helpful and sensible price.

Great experience with the company after failed start with other companies.  They delivered exactly as quoted meeting quality, cost and schedule.  Other companies quoted but could not actually do the installation even after signing contract with them.   Essential Energy Solutions conducted a site visit to confirm what was actually required for quoting and were able to complete the 10KW system install in the day.
Really enjoyed dealing with Essential Energy solutions.They did a great job.

Great friendly service, Kurt was excellent to deal with and explained all about the system in great detail. Professional installation was on agreed day and hassle free. Installer Matt went above and beyond in thoroughly explaining and detailing the features of the system.  We are extremely happy with the company and the finished product.
Very happy with them. Great customer service. Would recommend them to anyone.

Kurt was easy to talk to and he gave me a competitive quote with no hassle or bull. I was able to call him and the office at  any time to ask about the quote, installation and general information and was happy with the relationship. The installation date was not as early as we wanted as they were quite busy, but installation was done with minimal fuss or doing without power in a good time frame. Grid connection was done as far as I know on the day. Any mess was cleared away and all areas were left clean. The team was polite and helpful  and completed the job by 3 pm. I am very happy with Essential Energy Solutions at this early stage, but do not anticipate any problems in the future.

Our family ended up having 2 solar systems installed by this company on the same day in November.  This is a great company to deal with.Quotes were quick and comprehensive and there was never any pressure to buy.  They were very responsive to questions we asked, going to a lot of trouble in one instance to work out the potential impacts of shading from a very large tree about 28 metres from one of the sites.  The configuration was excellent (7 east and 11 x 370w panels west), giving us near perfect maximum output of about 5kw from late morning to late afternoon when we can use power the most.Installation was fantastic.  The install team were friendly, on time and kept us informed right through the install process.  They also gave us some really good information on how to choose an energy plan to maximise solar savings.  Overall a neat and tidy job.  We had a small problem with one of the Fronius data cards, wouldn't connect to the internet, but again their response was excellent, Lois quickly arranging installation of a new card in time for Christmas.   All of the staff we spoke to (in particular Kurt, Matt, Mitch, and Lois and Sarah from Admin) were polite and very helpful.Couldn't be happier with the service, install or choice of system components.  We're already making huge savings, December was a negative power bill and January is well on track to being negative as well.  It’s unlikely we’ll be paying for electricity again until maybe winter when solar production drops off a little.We obtained 6 separate quotes and Essential Energy were clearly the most competitive in terms of quality and value for money.  Overall we would highly recommend them.And finally a special thanks to Solar Quotes for providing an outstanding and very helpful solar information service.

Essential Energy gets it right from the get go, asking all the right questions about our power usage to giving us all the options available within our budget, to the professional installation that performs like it was stated.The team turned up on time, were polite and friendly and after finishing, sat down to make sure we understood everything about how to operate and utilise our new solar system.They organised everything with Energex to get us hooked up to the system, as well as follow up emails to make sure the whole process went smoothly.A solar system is a huge investment, with long term ramifications if not done right, and for that reason We highly recommend Essential Energy for all your solar needs.

Quoting was straight forward. Included a site visit and discussion of options. Price was most competitive vs other quotes given the system components.Installation team was punctual and tidy. Installation was to my satisfactionApart from the issue with the 2 inverters communicating with each other, which hopefully will be rectified soon, I am happy with the install.I'm still awaiting the changeover of my meter by my energy provider, so cannot comment on ease of grid connection yet. Unfortunately the Xmas/New Year break has fallen just after my install, so other processes are a little delayed.

Essential Energy got in touch with me within 24 hours of the request to discuss the quote. Lois took initial information and arranged for Kurt to come and visit. He spent around 45 minutes asking and answering questions. He was very thorough and had a number of quotes ready within hours.The installers led by Grant were incredibly professional. As they were installing to the five townhouses in our development, they were here for a whole week. During that time Grant gave us regular updates about issues they had found and about how the panels and inverters worked etc.The customer services was impeccable. From Lois to Kurt to Grant and finally to Sarah who wrapped up the process by organising the paperwork for our distributor and retailer, everyone involved listened and took the time to explain every step of the process.I have no hesitation recommending Essential Energy.

A technician first visited the property and offered solid recommendation give my situation (I already have a system that needed additional capacity).Fast installation and competitive price.Highly recommended.

I was happy with all three companies that SolarQuotes matched me with, and, to be honest, it was hard to choose between them. All three had great reviews and came across as professional, knowledgeable and competent. In the end I went with Essential Energy because their website seemed to be the most complete and they seemed to have been around installing solar for longest.The sales guy who visited to provide an initial quote was very well presented and very professional. Their was a fairly common rate of 11.1 cents for feed-in, with the odd one out offering 12.5 cents.When I put the hard word on AGL for more Feed-in, they agreed to give me 20.0 cents if I droped the 25% discount I was getting on Peak and Controlled Load usage.Over the last 12 months we have used 5,024 Kw of Peak, and 1,115 Kw of Controlled, for a total of 6,139 Kw, and a total power price of $2,635, after the 25% discount is made.With the 6.6Kw system being installed, the probable Feed-in would be about 10,450Kw less the approximate usage of about 5,000Kw, and the excess being Feed-in, would give us about $1,000 less whatever they will continue to charge for Lines & Poles, leaves us about $500 "in the black"!Unless you know something I don't about my calculations, and send an urgent email saying DON"T DO IT, I will be going for the $0.20 option!Thanks for the very important part you have played in our choice to go Solar.Best regards, and in much admiration of your contribution,Graham and HeatherP.S.
